## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D2. This is audit backlog UX-17 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: Receptionist on /today, /settings, the chart and the consultation; nurse on /settings and a consultation; practice admin on the chart · Local and Azure.
Findings and reviewers: F-17, part of F-28 · reviewers A-20, A-21.
Rationale: The server refuses correctly, but the screen says Page not found. The link may be old. A person thinks the product is broken. A nurse opening a consultation sees two red error lines.
Proposed UX behaviour: When the server answers 403 for a route, or the client knows the role lacks the capability, the page shows PageMessage in its denied state: Your role does not include this screen, with one button to the role's start page. A missing or switched-off route keeps Page not found. A nurse on a consultation sees this one calm message, not two errors. The message never says what the screen holds and never names a patient.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md section 3 (A screen a role may not open says so).
Components and tokens affected: PageMessage (denied). i18n keys in en, hi and ar.
Front end and back end split: Front end only. The server's refusals are unchanged and are not relaxed.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the page components ticket (PageMessage).
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Effort and regression risk: S · Low. The control is on the server; this is only the message.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Any change to who may open what. (2) Hiding Today for roles that only get the board (the navigation names ticket).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a receptionist, when she opens /today, /settings or a consultation address, then the page says her role does not include this screen and offers the start page
- [ ] **AC2.** Given any role, when an address that does not exist is opened, then the page says Page not found
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the same role, when the API behind the screen is called directly, then it answers 403, and the authorisation tests for those endpoints are unchanged
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a nurse opening a consultation, when the page renders, then one denied message shows and no red error lines
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the denied page, when its text and address are read, then they hold no patient name, MRN or clinical word
- [ ] **AC6.** Given English and Arabic, when axe runs, then there is no violation and the message has one h1

## Test notes

- tests/e2e/desk-access.spec.ts and clinical-access.spec.ts: assert the denied message for each role and route listed.
- tests/e2e/fullstack/access.spec.ts: the server still answers 403.
